description: This file contains implementation code for exporting PyTorch JIT graphs to ONNX format, including functions for serializing models, handling tensors, and encoding computational graphs into ONNX protobuf structures. It defines a GraphEncoder class responsible for converting a Torch JIT graph into ONNX format, managing external data storage, attributes, and type information, as well as utility functions for serialization and shape inference.

classes.description: A class responsible for converting a Torch JIT graph into ONNX format, managing model proto creation, graph encoding, attribute and tensor handling, and external data management.
